newsitem.title: USA: Playboy Q3 boosted by entertainment group.
newsitem.headline: Playboy Q3 boosted by entertainment group.

text.p: Playboy Enterprises Inc said Wednesday its higher fiscal third quarter results were driven by operating income from its entertainment group that more than tripled, to $6.2 million from $1.8 million a year ago.
The entertainment group's revenues, benefiting from higher satellite direct-to-home revenues, rose 27 percent, to $19.2 million from $15.1 million.
Operating income for the publishing group was essentially flat at $1.5 million, while revenues gained six percent to $32.2 million.
Playboy magazine revenues declined slightly to $24.3 million from $24.5 million a year earlier.
Magazine advertising pages for the fiscal fourth quarter, begun April 1, are expected to be up about 14 percent, the company said.
